title: The Missing Clue
instruction: Share your field reports and agree which site to restore so the North Canopy squirrels can spread.
intro: Each Guardian surveyed a different part of the River Edge. Nobody has the whole picture — talk it through. Your corridor rule matters: it changes which trees wildlife can already reach.

deduction.question: Which site should the team restore first?

candidates.label: Site D — fig by the grove
Site G — open patch by the grove

clues.text: Giant squirrels from the North Canopy can already reach a tree right beside our site — under the corridor rule we chose.
The macaque troop in the south-east can NOT reach any tree beside our site yet — under our corridor rule. This one is for the squirrels.
Our site is degraded forest, not bare ground.
The site is in the northern half of the map.
There is no fig tree at the site.
It will not heal by itself this season — under the recovery rule we chose.

challenge.text: Agree on the right site without a wrong guess.
